explication: Arkime captures live or file-based network traffic, parses it into sessions, stores packets as PCAP and indexes session metadata in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch. An analyst uses the Viewer to build searches, inspect sessions, visualize SPI data, and export packets. Optional Cont3xt and wiseService add enrichment and threat-intelligence workflows, while Parliament monitors multiple Arkime clusters. Sampled code confirms query construction, session API calls, enrichment endpoints, and the major UI entry points; some internal capture wiring is inferred from documented component roles.
